hook: Why Only Joy Would Make You Unhappy

voices.name: l00
voices.text: A life with only good things. <#0.2#> Would it really make you happy?
voices.caption: A life with only good things. Would it really make you happy?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: In a world of only cold, <#0.2#> you'd never know what cold is.
voices.caption: In a world of only cold, you'd never know what cold is.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Without darkness, <#0.2#> you couldn't recognize light.
voices.caption: Without darkness, you couldn't recognize light.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: You can like something <#0.2#> only because there are things you dislike.
voices.caption: You can like something only because there are things you dislike.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Because there is sorrow, <#0.3#> we know joy.
voices.caption: Because there is sorrow, we know joy.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: So don't hate the dark. <#0.2#> It's an experience just as precious.
voices.caption: So don't hate the dark. It's an experience just as precious.
